summary: J.Jill, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that its Board of Directors declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share. The dividend is payable on October 7, 2026, to holders of record as of September 23, 2026. This is an ordinary capital return event consistent with the company's ongoing quarterly dividend program, not a special situation such as a special dividend, tender offer, or other strategic transaction. The filing contains no unusual terms, no premium, and no structural or advisory details. There is no special-situation angle to watch; this is a routine current report.
